description: Get a law checklist for the product, for example the PDPA 2027 checklist: the rules of that law that apply to these facts, each with what to look for in the code (look_for) or ask the user (ask). Use it when the user asks whether their project is ready for the PDPA. Send country codes and facts only. Mark each item Found (with file and line), Missing or Can't tell from code; never give a score.

company_in.description: ISO country code where the company (or maker) is, e.g. 'LK'
company_in.title: Company In

facts.description: List of the facts that are true, from get_fact_questions
facts.title: Facts

processing_in.description: ISO country codes where data is stored or processed
processing_in.title: Processing In

users_in.description: ISO country codes where users are, as the user said, e.g. ['LK']
users_in.title: Users In

name: get_checklist
